author: TickTockFilms
body:
Hello, My name is stadd5.

A couple of days ago, I was banned for killaura and other hacks by a senior moderator (Kaliks 12)

I am both here to appeal for my ban, and to thank him.

"wait what? thank him?"


"r u 4 rlz?"

Yes random spectator voices inside my/your head, I am going to thank him.

I was using the hack client for multiple reasons.

1. For maximum convenience on my other server. If youd like to try it the ip is dw- NO NO NO NO ADVERTISING, MIND- PLEASE STAY ON TRACK!
2.Normal minecraft was getting boring!

I have had bad experience with hacks, except they weren't the type of hacking that I was performing.
I installed the hack client out of complete curiosity and boredom.


I didn't mean to do ANYONE harm, and I am truly sorry for all the hacking I performed.
I have not hacked since the day I was banned from this server (albeit on my own server).

I am truly sorry for my crimes and hope to be unbanned as this server holds quite a few memories for me (EG. friends that I have lost to games like HALO... We all used to play on this server)
Thankyou for banning me as I have realized my mistakes... What I did goes against everything I used to stand for


Have a good Day/Night/State of Temporal flux

replies.body:

I appreciate the fact that you seem sorry for you actions, that's good of you. However, considering the fact that your ban is very recent, I will not appeal this, please try again in a couple of months. 

Regards,
